items.summary: US securities settlement group DTCC has announced a blockchain-based tokenisation service that it plans to bring into commercial use in October 2026, according to DTCC and secondary reports. The service is planned to cover 25 securities at launch and to run on the Canton and Hyperledger Besu networks, with Stellar and Circle's Arc expected in 2027. Kaupr, which reported the story, says the securities include US Treasuries, ETFs and Russell 1000 shares. We have not confirmed that the service is already live.
